texts.zh:
强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。

突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。

一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。

所见何物？
texts.en:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange presence settles around us.

WHAT DID YOU SEE?

label.zh: 我们看到了生机勃勃的森林。
label.en: We saw a forest, rich with many lifeforms.

label.en: We saw a wasteland, stripped of all it had to offer.

texts.zh:
寂静渐强。那个心声又回来了……

很好。

一股强大的暖流涌上我们全身，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
texts.en:
The silence swells. The voice returns...

EXCELLENT.

A powerful heat surges within us, then subsides. The presence has departed.

texts.zh:
那个心声回来了……

没门！

一种极端的严寒填满了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
texts.en:
The voice returns...

NEVER!

An extreme coldness pools within us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

texts.zh:
那个心声回来了……

无趣。

一种极端的空虚压垮了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
texts.en:
The voice returns...

HOW UNINTERESTING.

An extreme emptiness overcomes us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.
